Welcome

A Haven of Tranquility in Goa

Welcome to Vento Sereno, a place we're proud to call our own — a haven of tranquility nestled just a short 5-minute stroll from the pristine shores of Candolim Beach in Goa.

Our property is surrounded by lush greenery that paints a soothing backdrop for your stay. It's our privilege to provide you with an oasis of calm, where you can escape the chaos of the world and find solace in the beauty of nature.

Vento Sereno is not just a place to stay; it's an embodiment of our passion for hospitality and our dedication to ensuring your stay is a memorable one.

5 min to Candolim Beach
What We Offer

Comfort in Every Detail

🌿

Lush Surroundings

Warm, inviting rooms set within lush natural greenery. A minute's walk from Candolim market for all your daily needs.

📺

Smart Amenities

Smart TVs with Hotstar Premium, private bathrooms and balconies, plus complimentary high-speed WiFi throughout.

🚗

Free Parking

Complimentary private parking amidst the greenery of Candolim. Arrive at ease and let the cool breeze welcome you.

🏖️

Prime Location

Under 1 km from Candolim Beach, 2.4 km from Calangute, and 2.6 km from Sinquerim. You're at the heart of it all.

🌅

Private Balconies

Enjoy your morning tea or evening breeze from your very own private balcony with garden views and fresh Goan air.

⭐

100% Satisfaction

First visit or tenth — our staff is always on hand to ensure your experience is nothing short of excellent.

Our Story

Your Home Away from Home

We consist of a team of professionals striving to make your stay comfortable, memorable, and enjoyable — whether you're here for business or leisure.

Each room is equipped with a desk, flat-screen TV, private bathroom, bed linen, fridge, towels, wardrobe, and kettle. Select rooms offer beautiful garden views.

We take pride in our commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. Our green initiatives ensure that your stay has a minimal impact on the environment.

Policies

House Rules

01

Check-in: 2:00 PM  ·  Check-out: 11:30 AM

02

Early check-in and late check-out will be charged extra as per guest house policy.

03

Room extensions require availability check. Pay and extend well in advance for a hassle-free stay.

04

Every guest must produce a valid photo ID with address at the time of check-in.

05

No refund on cancellation for any reason.

06

Outside visitors are not permitted in guest rooms.

07

Smoking in rooms is strictly prohibited.

08

Outside food and liquor are not permitted in rooms.

09

Please keep room keys intact. Loss of key will be charged ₹1,000.

10

Linen is changed every third day upon guest request.

11

Management accepts no liability for money, valuables, or vehicles on the premises.

12

Any damage to property will be compensated by the guest. Inverter backup for 2 lights and a fan.
